articles.title: AP bets big on space economy with India's first integrated space city near Sriharikota
articles.summary: Andhra Pradesh is planning India's first ₹25,000-crore private space city in Tirupati. It signifies a major leap in India's private space sector, fostering indigenous capabilities and creating significant opportunities in space technology and innovation, aligning with national self-reliance goals.
